parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the storage cabinet made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the shelves and doors, maintaining the cabinet’s shape and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that supports all other components.

parts.name: Shelf 1
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal shelf panel made of plywood, part of the cabinet interior.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items and divides the cabinet space into sections.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or occasionally adjustable but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf 2
parts.Basic_description: A middle shelf made of plywood, part of the cabinet’s internal structure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a surface for storing items and helps distribute weight evenly.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable but not designed for frequent movement.

parts.name: Shelf 3
parts.Basic_description: A central shelf made of plywood, part of the cabinet’s internal layout.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the cabinet vertically and supports stored objects.

parts.name: Shelf 4
parts.Basic_description: An upper shelf made of plywood, part of the cabinet’s storage system.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional storage space for smaller or lighter items.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable but not movable during normal operation.

parts.name: Shelf 5
parts.Basic_description: A top shelf made of plywood, part of the cabinet’s internal structure.
parts.Functional_description: It supports items placed at the top section of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door 1
parts.Basic_description: A lower cabinet door made of plywood with a handle for access.
parts.Functional_description: It covers and protects the lower storage compartment, allowing access when opened.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door 2
parts.Basic_description: A lower cabinet door made of plywood, part of the front access system.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the lower storage area and protects contents from dust.
parts.Movement_description: It swings open and closed on hinges.

parts.name: Cabinet Door 3
parts.Basic_description: A middle cabinet door made of plywood, part of the cabinet’s front section.
parts.Functional_description: It conceals and provides access to the middle storage compartment.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates on hinges for opening and closing.

parts.name: Cabinet Door 4
parts.Basic_description: A middle cabinet door made of plywood, part of the cabinet’s front access system.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the middle section of the cabinet and protects stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It swings open and closed using hinges.

parts.name: Cabinet Door 5
parts.Basic_description: An upper cabinet door made of plywood, part of the cabinet’s front structure.
parts.Functional_description: It covers the upper storage compartment and provides access when opened.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates on hinges for opening and closing.

parts.name: Cabinet Door 6
parts.Basic_description: An upper cabinet door made of plywood, part of the cabinet’s front access system.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the top storage area and protects items inside.
parts.Movement_description: It swings open and closed on hinges.
